def format_title(artist: str, title: str) -> str:
    """Removes artist name if "Genius" is in the artist name

    Args:
        artist (str): item artist.
        title (str): item title/name.

    Returns:
        str: formatted title.
    """
    if "Genius" in artist:
        final_title = title
    else:
        final_title = f"{artist} - {title}"
    return final_title
